version_boundary.meaning: Clear only inactive abort latch at real final release; cancel status preserved, no debt clear or earlier done. The four earlier complete-N measurements remain frozen prior-core evidence. Current complete WO and directed tests validate affected cleanup; they do not turn prior QKV/Wi/Down into newly executed current-core full-N tests. Stress prefix ends before matrix-wide final release, so its tested branch is unchanged.
version_boundary.testbench_boundary: AT012/AT021/AT029 preserve exact TB/build/snapshot. Later TB adds true event logs and bounded recovery checks; changed A publication observation can shift AXI peer global phase and cold service. Do not attribute a cold-cycle difference to the abort repair.
